contentText:
The Moto Pad will be available in a single bronze green color option. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge

Motorola announced two new devices today , including one of its first tablets to be available from a US carrier since Verizon's Xyboard tablets in 2011. The new Moto Pad is joined by the 2026 edition of the Moto G Stylus featuring an upgraded pen that responds to tilt and pressure changes in supported apps.

The Moto Pad will be available through T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile starting on April 30th, or it can be purchased through Motorola's online store by T-Mobile customers for $249.99 in a single bronze green color option.
